name: Defend
doc: Defend (the command): the root and the director - the two shields in front of the caster (the large one shrinking onto him, the small one flickering), the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag183_defend.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The two shields in front of the caster (the large one shrinking onto him, the small one flickering), the sound; the action result

params.label: Sound
params.doc: At the director's tick 1 (3D, at the caster)

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The action result at this tick of the director

params.label: Shield a model
params.doc: The prim model shield a (a mesh of 31 vertices, 30 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Shield b model
params.doc: The prim model shield b (a mesh of 81 vertices, 80 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
